task_metadata.research_topic: weather forecast variable aggregation across heterogeneous meteorological variables
task_metadata.research_question: How should a weather forecasting model aggregate information across heterogeneous meteorological variables for optimal prediction?
notes: Baselines map to standard set-aggregation families used in ClimaX-style multivariable weather forecasting.
Mean pooling is a standard operation and does not have a single canonical paper.

tests.label: z500-3day
tests.notes: ClimaX fine-tuning target evaluated with WeatherBench-style metrics on ERA5.

tests.label: t850-5day
tests.notes: Temperature target from the same ClimaX/WeatherBench evaluation family.

tests.label: wind10m-7day
tests.notes: Wind target from the ClimaX-style ERA5 forecasting benchmark.

baselines.name: cross_attention
baselines.notes: ClimaX uses a learnable query with cross-attention over variable tokens; Perceiver is a close cross-attention analogue.

baselines.name: learned_weighted_sum
baselines.notes: Channel/feature reweighting via softmax-weighted sum is closest to squeeze-and-excitation style gating.

baselines.name: self_attention
baselines.notes: Variable self-attention is directly grounded in Transformer-style attention and set-attention models.
